async def act(page):
    # Scroll to the bottom of the homepage to ensure all content is loaded
    await page.evaluate('window.scrollTo(0, document.body.scrollHeight)')
    await page.wait_for_timeout(3000)  # Wait for dynamic content
    
    # Click the 'Older posts' link to navigate to page 2 using Accessibility Tree-centric selector
    try:
        older_posts_link = page.get_by_role('link', name='Older posts', exact=True)
        await older_posts_link.click(timeout=10000)  # Increase timeout to 10 seconds
        await page.wait_for_load_state('load')
        print('Navigated to page 2 of the blog feed.')
    except Exception as e:
        print(f'Error clicking link: {e}')
        return
